externalSchedule.schedule: 08:00 start plus 5-minute same-task continuation window through 09:55 Asia/Shanghai
outerAgentProtocol: Every wake first uses the read-only status entrypoint. If the exact business date has no run, create one exact run only inside the continuation window. Otherwise reuse the one run_id returned by the workflow SQLite authority; never create a second run.
Run the public entrypoint for that exact run. Read the final compact stdout summary and the exact run-scoped workflow_handoff.json it names; do not depend on one large stdout payload.

When the public entrypoint reports waiting_stage or waiting_stage_process, end only this bounded outer turn. The same ai-rebuild heartbeat and fixed task wakes again in five minutes, reuses the exact run, and lets the process lock either report truthful waiting or resume the latest committed checkpoint.

When editorial is required, directly apply the active ai-account-editorial-director Skill in this outer Codex task and save the simple stage result. The handoff contains only high-potential events with completed representative deep reading; cover those candidate identities exactly once. Each decision must cite that candidate's own available fact, missing dimension, or content judgment; do not reuse generic batch reasons. For each select, observe, reject, or failed row, include its existing evidence_source_ids and a decision_basis with concrete traffic, content, persona and differentiation facts. Real engagement and exact time or recency establish traffic opportunity; title value, persona fit, and exploration stay separate. Pre-read angle hypotheses are non-blocking inputs, not final Austin angles. The runtime keeps all unqualified events as signal-only ledger rows without asking the Skill to judge metadata-only cards.

When scripts_required is returned, read each selected topic's joined same-run Topic Card. Keep factual constraints in generation and QA context; the candidate Voice Skill owns spoken narrative structure.

In this outer Codex task, apply candidate austin-no-overtime-scripting once for the full batch and candidate austin-voice-scriptwriter once for the full batch, then save the simple stage result. Do not fabricate a measured personal saving, real client outcome, completed team result, or verified third-party statistic.
Run the same public entrypoint with the simple stage result files until local terminal completion.

The owner-only publisher client reads its runtime-only config and attempts one terminal snapshot. Publish pending is not a business failure. Later continuation wakes return terminal noop and never repeat completed upstream stages, Skills, or an applied Website POST.
